body.objective: Break sampler monoculture for the positive Bateman--Turok Euclidean lattice and test whether a lowest-mode interaction proxy has a reproducible finite-size change from L=4 to L=6.
activates: replicated L=6 autocorrelation measurements after the precision gate is specified
an L=8 finite-volume point only after cross-sampler precision agreement
matched-coupling continuum step scaling if the finite-volume sequence stabilizes
body.current_gate: Implement a local detailed-balance sampler independently of the HMC force, calibrate it against the exact free theory, compare action and lowest-mode moments at L=4 and L=6, and decide whether the two-volume interaction-proxy step is resolved by both algorithms.
body.stop_condition: Land a block-level observation artifact, strict certificate and method-distinct verifier that either establish coarse independent reproduction and a resolved two-volume proxy step, or classify the sampling or precision obstruction without promoting a continuum claim.
body.forbid: no four-sigma compatibility called precision equivalence; no finite-volume proxy called a renormalized continuum coupling; no continuum-limit, reflection-positivity, analytic-continuation, q8-q10, gravity, BV--BRST, QME or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL promotion
body.resource_hint: Use u_L=2-M4/M2^2 for the axis-pooled lowest complex Fourier mode. Store block sufficient statistics and compute delete-one-block errors without rerunning the chains. Require exact local-delta checks and a free Gaussian calibration. Keep all runs sequential under the 500 MB virtual-memory cap.
